observed_runtime_before_fix.interpretation: Seven of the eight core initial official datasets were successfully transported through the official-source relay. One core dataset remained unresolved; this is a transport/data retrieval issue, not evidence that all exchange APIs are down.

changes: Relay calls now retry transient 429, 5xx, timeout and network failures with short jittered backoff.
Core initial datasets that remain unavailable after the parallel first pass receive a serial second-pass retry with up to three relay attempts.
The top source badge now names the exact remaining limited dataset when exactly one item is unresolved.
Source cards now list unresolved status keys instead of showing only a generic count.
Canonical official source_url attribution is unchanged; relay remains transport metadata only.

source_validation.note: Official catalogs still define the core endpoints used by Lumen. Browser direct reachability is tracked separately from official endpoint existence.

raw_facts: The live browser reported 0 direct / 7 relay / 1 limited before this repair.
TWSE MI_INDEX remains readable with 2026-08-07 official rows.
TWSE, TPEx and TAIFEX official API catalogs still list the relevant Lumen endpoints.
lumen_calculation: No investment-direction forecast was generated by this maintenance run.
rule_interpretation: A single relay miss after seven successes is treated first as a transient transport/upstream retrieval issue and retried; it is not relabeled as an exchange outage without independent evidence.
If the retry still fails, the UI exposes the exact dataset name so the next repair can be endpoint-specific.
risk_limitations: This maintenance environment cannot resolve the Supabase project hostname, so the user's browser remains the authoritative end-to-end observation for relay reachability.
The exact previously limited dataset could not be independently recovered from the aggregate badge alone; the updated UI now surfaces its name.
GitHub combined status returned no status records for the latest code commit, so CI success is not claimed.
Cloudflare lumen-script.pages.dev writable project remains unverified/not synchronized.
